field_principles.aggregate_row_recomputation: Independent reduction catches identifiability or conformance summaries that contradict rows.
field_principles.attack_matrix: Explicit attacks test empty, duplicate, stale, and changed-class failure modes before reuse.
field_principles.collision_witnesses: Constructive policy pairs turn a failed audit into replayable evidence instead of an opaque score.
field_principles.duration_s: Wall time catches a structural audit that never completed enumeration.
field_principles.estimand_definition: A named target effect prevents the audit from proving identifiability for the wrong claim.
field_principles.field_principles: A principle map carries design intent into later audits and artifacts.
field_principles.field_provenance: Per-field source paths and hashes prevent unsupported summary values.
field_principles.gate_check_summary: A blocked state must identify the failed structural or receipt check and its observed value.
field_principles.honest_verdict: The verdict states whether the protocol is identifying without converting class-relative proof into a global claim.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Declaring deterministic_synthetic_protocol_audit_no_llm prevents fixture enumeration from being reported as model evidence.
field_principles.leave_one_support_out_rows: Leave-one-out rows detect supports that appear sufficient only because a critical cell was not challenged.
field_principles.minimum_identifying_support: A minimal support exposes which observations are load-bearing for the causal claim.
field_principles.observation_support_manifest: The exact observed cells determine what behavioral differences the protocol can see.
field_principles.per_unit_rows: Pair, support, attack, and phase rows let an auditor recompute every conclusion.
field_principles.policy_class_manifest: A frozen finite policy class makes the scope of the identifiability claim explicit.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Preflight receipts prove the declared policy class, reducer, and runtime schema existed before testing.
field_principles.protected_files_unchanged: The preflight must not alter protected evaluators or roadmap machinery.
field_principles.protocol_identifying_score: A conjunctive binary gate prevents downstream inference when the observation protocol cannot identify the target effect.
field_principles.random_seed: A fixed seed reproduces any support-search ordering and attack sampling.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: The checksum binds policy class, support, estimand, code, and result.
field_principles.status: A terminal status distinguishes a completed structural proof from an interrupted search.
field_principles.task_scoped_receipt_rows: Phase receipts attribute time, process, bytes, and exact verification to this task rather than global activity.
field_principles.tests_run: Recorded commands prove the reusable API and attacks were executed.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: Exhaustive finite enumeration and receipt arithmetic are exact within the frozen policy class only.
